name: AI Knowledge Lab · Agent-native criteria
periodScheme: YYYY-MM-WN = Nth 7-day block of the calendar month (Asia/Shanghai), not ISO week
meaning: The Lab is agent-native when an external agent can discover capabilities, resolve schemas, and fetch canonical Markdown/JSON without scraping HTML or inventing tool names.

gates.ask: Do the stable agent surfaces exist?
Is discover → execute documented as the only protocol?
Do discover.json and tools.json advertise the same tool names?
Does every catalog knowledge entry point at an existing /content/**/*.md?
Do content/index.json and api/catalog.json share the same id order?
Does llms.txt list SKILL, discover, tools, catalog, and content?
Does the Agent Card declare discover/catalog/skill and stay read-only?
Are Projects exposed as JSON (not HTML-only), with a non-empty personal snapshot?
Do production HTTPS surfaces return 2xx? (schedule uses --live)
